baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled خ ر ج construction, يخرجوا ... وما هم بخارجين, negates both attempted motion and achieved status, while عذاب مقيم names what remains.
baseline_models.mechanism: A desired passage is aimed from an enclosing fire toward an outside, but the verbal attempt is answered by a negated participial state. The punishment does not merely follow the failed passage; its residence outlasts and encloses the attempt.

activation_trace.role: Penetration to the outside supplies the literal boundary crossing, and its repetition makes failed crossing the mechanism's hinge.
The kindled fire supplies the enclosing punitive medium from which the crossing is sought.
Severe pain and punishment identify the enclosure as an imposed consequence rather than a neutral location.
Residence in a place supplies persistence, making the punishment the stable term against the attempted exit.

changed_reading.before: They want to leave the fire but cannot, and their punishment is lasting.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a sealed topology: desire initiates outward motion, grammar cancels arrival outside, and the punishment remains the stable enclosing state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يريدون supplies volition, the repeated خ ر ج supplies a proposed trajectory, and مقيم opposes it with arrested continuity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah separates willing from effective motion. The back-and-forth branch of ر و د makes the desire dynamically restless, but the repeated exit root never crosses its boundary and the closing adjective fixes the outcome in place.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention supply the initiating force, which the rest of the construction tests for efficacy.
Coming and going without settling supplies an oscillatory image for desire that remains active but gains no outward distance.
Outward passage gives the will a direction, while its positive-negative repetition records non-completion.
Stopping, immobility, and inability to continue supply the counterforce that turns directed desire into motion without progress.

changed_reading.before: Their wish is psychologically present but simply denied.
changed_reading.after: Their wish is an active but closed loop: it repeatedly points outward while the terminal condition remains stationary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عذاب is immediately qualified by مقيم after the explicit denial of خروج.
baseline_models.mechanism: The withholding branch of ع ذ ب and the maintenance branch of ق و م allow the final phrase to function as more than a duration label. The punishment can be carried as an established retaining regime that continually preserves the no-exit condition.

activation_trace.role: Withholding, prevention, and weaning supply a restraint image, making punishment the bar against the proposed exit.
Care, preservation, and continuous oversight supply the functional maintenance of the restraint.
Literal outward passage is the action that this proposed retaining regime continuously blocks.

changed_reading.before: مقيم says that the punishment lasts.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, عذاب مقيم is an established retainer: its persistence is the mechanism that keeps the denied exit denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 5:29, an earlier human إرادة is joined to bearing wrong and becoming a companion of fire; the supplied ب و ء branch adds a return-upon-owner image. This makes the focus desire feel like a late counter-will: a wish to reverse a fire-bearing relation whose consequence has already returned and become habitation.

activation_trace.role: The focus will supplies the attempted reversal away from the already realized fire relation.
Outward passage gives the counter-will its desired direction and exposes its failure.
The earlier stated will supplies the pericope's forward volitional pole toward bearing guilt and fire.
A thing returning upon its owner supplies the rebound by which an intended burden becomes an inescapable consequence.
Companionship and inseparable association turn fire from a visited place into a relation of belonging.
The earlier fire occurrence supplies the destination of the first will and the enclosure opposed by the later will.

structural_cues: 5:29 and 5:37 repeat إرادة and النار in opposed directions, while 5:29 places fire inside a bearing-and-companionship construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated will/fire lexemes, consequence-bearing, and companionship; I supply the reversal arrow from an earlier will toward fire to a later will away from it. The live alternative is motif-level contrast rather than identity of speakers or subjects.

changed_reading.before: The focus records an isolated wish to escape.
changed_reading.after: The wish becomes a rebounding counter-will, trying too late to reverse a consequence already figured as returned burden and companionship with fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence before the focus presents timed capacity, seeking a means, strenuous movement on a path, hoped-for success, and finally an all-scale ransom that is not accepted. The no-exit clause therefore reads as closure after available channels of release have been missed or rejected, not as bare spatial incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Outward passage supplies the release whose possible channels are tested and then closed by the context.
Effective capacity and control supply a temporal threshold before which a change of course still matters.
Active seeking supplies the search for a usable means rather than passive wishing.
A traversable extended path supplies the pre-focus route on which effort can still move toward success.
Substitution by ransom supplies a final transactional release mechanism.
Acceptance with satisfaction is explicitly denied, closing the ransom channel before the focus closes bodily egress.

structural_cues: 5:33 can expel offenders from the land, 5:34 marks repentance before capture, 5:35 commands seeking the means and striving on the way, and 5:36 rejects even an earth-sized ransom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several distinct release-related acts in sequence; I arrange them as progressively closing channels whose terminal spatial image is 5:37. They could instead be independent exhortative and punitive details rather than one phased closure.

changed_reading.before: They cannot cross the fire's boundary.
changed_reading.after: They face terminal closure after timely turning, sought means, traversable effort, and exchange have ceased to function as exits.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, punishment is imaged as a restraining deterrent, yet repentance joined to repair is followed by covering the wrong and its effect. This contrast sharpens مقيم: the focus punishment is the terminal regime precisely because no repair-and-covering release is stated inside it.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and prevention supply the retaining side of the focus punishment.
Continued residence makes retention terminal rather than a temporary disciplinary interval.
A binding restraint that prevents and repels supplies a nearby model of punishment as behavior-stopping discipline.
Restoration against corruption supplies the substantive repair that can alter the penal trajectory.
Covering the wrong and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies the available release after repair.

structural_cues: 5:39 grammatically joins turning after wrongdoing to reform before announcing divine turning and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deterrent restraint, repair, and protective covering; I infer a contrast between reversible discipline and the focus's terminal retention. The alternative is that the adjacent rulings concern categorically different subjects and should not be staged as phases.

changed_reading.after: مقيم marks the punishment as beyond the nearby repair-and-covering release valve: restraint has become terminal retention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus human will is surrounded by divine willing to punish or forgive, willing trial, not willing purification, and the addressee's inability to possess anything against God. Desire to exit is thus not only frustrated motion; it is will stripped of governing capacity inside an asymmetrical field of agency.

activation_trace.role: Human will and intention supply the focus agency whose effective reach is being measured.
Will directed toward an object supplies the explicit governing choice between punishment and forgiveness.
Sovereignty supplies the capacity that makes one will effective rather than merely desired.
The repeated divine will supplies a direct lexical counterweight to the focus subjects' will.
Testing a person as metal is tested supplies the process governed by the stronger will.
Removal of impurity supplies the unrealized alternative outcome explicitly placed under divine will.

structural_cues: 5:40 repeats يشاء around punishment and forgiveness; 5:41 repeats يرد around trial and purification and states that no one can possess anything against God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed grammatical subjects of willing and an explicit sovereignty/incapacity frame; I infer that efficacy, not intensity of desire, decides the focus outcome. A live alternative is that the focus only reports result while the context separately explains divine judgment.

changed_reading.before: They strongly want an exit that is unavailable.
changed_reading.after: Their will is exposed as non-sovereign: it can name an exit but cannot govern punishment, purification, or the boundary itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:48 combines an accessible watering-place image, a clear road, and the declaration of common return. These directional cues recast the focus enclosure as part of a larger topology: legitimate paths differ, but movement converges in return, and no counterpath is available from the realized fire-state.

activation_trace.role: Outward penetration supplies the attempted counterpath whose absence becomes legible against the context's named ways.
A visible, accessible water source supplies a destination-oriented access point within an authorized way.
A manifest clear road supplies traversable direction rather than restless motion.
Return to what one came from supplies the common terminal direction that prevents exit from becoming an autonomous destination.

structural_cues: 5:48 places شرعة, منهاجا, competitive forward action, and the collective return to God in one directional sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies access, road, movement, and return; I infer a topology in which plural routes converge and the focus offers no reverse route after judgment. The alternative is to keep the legal pathways and eschatological enclosure in separate domains.

changed_reading.before: The fire is a local enclosure with no exit.
changed_reading.after: The fire is the terminal closed region of a directional system: paths existed before return, but no post-return counterpath leads outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:52 supplies impaired motion, circular movement, and hoped-for opening. Those images sharpen the baseline loop: the focus will circulates toward an opening, but the doubled exit denial with stationary punishment turns the hoped-for aperture into a closed circuit.

activation_trace.role: Back-and-forth unsettled movement supplies the focus circuit's repeated impulse.
Outward penetration supplies the opening repeatedly approached but never crossed.
Stopping and inability to continue fix the circuit around an immovable outcome.
Weakening and curtailed movement supply the incapacity that prevents motion from completing its aim.
Rotation, enclosure, and circling supply the spatial form of movement that returns without escaping.
The opening of what was closed supplies the absent aperture for which the focus desire implicitly reaches.

structural_cues: 5:52 portrays hurried movement driven by fear of a turning دائرة and hope for a فتح, placing circulation and aperture in direct tension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impaired movement, a feared turn, and hoped-for opening; I project that motion geometry onto the focus's desire-exit-stasis sequence. The alternative is a purely political cycle in 5:52 with no spatial bearing on 5:37.

changed_reading.after: Desire runs as a closed circuit around a withheld opening: motion persists, yet every turn returns to the established punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurrence of ق و م in 5:55 places those who continually establish prayer beside the focus's عذاب مقيم. The shared maintenance image changes the adjective from passive longevity into a standing order: one community sustains worship, while the focus subjects meet a punitive condition that remains sustained over them.

activation_trace.role: Ongoing care and preservation supply the processual persistence of the punishment.
Painful punishment supplies the standing regime being maintained.
Care, preservation, and constancy supply the active establishment of the contrasting practice.
Prayer as binding worship supplies the practice continuously established by the contrasted group.

structural_cues: The same root ق و م closes 5:37 as مقيم and appears in 5:55 as يقيمون governing الصلاة.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact root recurrence and a maintenance branch; I infer a contrast between two sustained regimes. The ordinary reading of مقيم as simply enduring remains fully live.

changed_reading.after: The punishment is a maintained standing order, set against the context's active maintenance of prayer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wider window repeatedly constructs belonging through companionship, proximity without interval, alliance, and party. Read against أصحاب النار, the focus's منها can carry a social-status enclosure as well as a spatial one: خروج would require disaffiliation from a realized belonging, and that separation is denied.

activation_trace.role: Separation from a state or place supplies the focus action recast as attempted disaffiliation.
Companionship and lasting association explicitly bind persons to the fire before the focus denies separation from it.
Nearness without an intervening gap supplies the relational geometry by which affiliation becomes enclosure.
Alliance and mutual support supply the chosen social bond whose consequences establish belonging.
A group consolidated around a shared position supplies the window's final explicit membership form.

structural_cues: 5:29 names companions of the fire; 5:51 says an affiliating person becomes منهم; 5:56 closes with party identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated membership constructions; I infer that spatial خروج can also image failed exit from an achieved status. This does not identify every group in the window or replace the literal fire enclosure.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they also cannot shed a realized belonging: the fire has become both enclosure and status-membership.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet normalizes both نار in the focus and نور in 5:44 and 5:46 under ن و ر while assigning different branch images. It remains valid as a packet-internal contrast anchored in the focus fire and context light, but downstream prose should call it an activation from supplied normalization, not claim that fire literally is guidance or settle historical etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: النار is the named medium from which خروج is denied.

activation_trace.role: Kindled fire supplies a visible but enclosing medium in the focus.
Outward passage supplies the route that this visible medium does not reveal or permit.
Light and illumination supply the guiding counterpart to the focus's fire branch.
Gentle direction toward a way and truth makes the context light route-giving rather than merely visible.
The repeated illumination strengthens the contrast between guidance that shows a way and fire that exposes without egress.

changed_reading.before: The fire is a burning prison.
changed_reading.after: As a contained packet-driven outlier, the fire is a terminal anti-beacon: it makes exposure unavoidable while yielding no path outward, unlike the nearby guiding نور.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر و د mapping to root_000555, then lets explicit ر د د at 5:54 activate return and reversal. It stays anchored in يريدون and the doubled خروج, but it should be rendered as a split-root resonance, never as a claim that ordinary إرادة lexically means apostasy or return.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يريدون initiates the doubled but unsuccessful attempt to be خارجين.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior place or condition supplies a retraction shadow inside the focus desire.
Repetition, oscillation, and hesitation supply a failed-reversal loop rather than a completed return.
Exit supplies the concrete action through which the attempted retraction would have to become effective.
Explicit return from a prior condition activates the shared mapped root and makes reversal a visible contextual mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They want a new outward movement.
changed_reading.after: Under the packet's split-root resonance, they seek to retract a realized condition, but the attempted return loops as desire and never becomes exit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a non-dominant ص ل و branch at the prayer occurrence carries contact with fire and heat, while ق و م links established prayer to مقيم punishment. The activation is branch-resolvable and focus-anchored in النار and مقيم, but prose must keep it a cross-domain hinge and must not equate prayer with fire or override the ordinary prayer branch.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: النار and عذاب مقيم join fire-contact to a standing, enduring condition.

activation_trace.role: Kindled fire supplies the focus medium against which the remote fire-contact branch becomes active.
Residence and duration supply the standing punitive condition.
Continuous care and maintenance supply the active establishment side of the hinge.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the surprising cross-domain contact image.
Prayer as binding worship preserves the ordinary contextual sense that contains the fire-contact resonance.

changed_reading.before: مقيم only says the punishment persists, while يقيمون الصلاة is unrelated ritual language.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, the shared establishment root and the split prayer/fire branches form a hinge between disciplined standing before judgment and compulsory standing in fire after it.

strongest_changes: The denied exit becomes terminal closure after earlier channels of timely turning, sought means, traversable effort, and ransom have failed.
The subjects' will is recast as non-sovereign by the nearby contrast with divine willing, ownership, trial, and purification.
عذاب مقيم can function as an established retaining regime, not only as a statement of long duration.
The wider path, opening, return, and affiliation language lets the fire operate simultaneously as sealed space, closed circuit, and realized status.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made movement and agency unusually dense around a very short ayah: repeated exit is activated by paths, exile, ransom, circular motion, opening, return, and competing wills, while split mappings expose carefully contained fire/light and desire/return resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the maintenance branches of ق و م should affect مقيم beyond its ordinary durative force.
Whether the packet-normalized نار/نور and ر و د/ر د د resonances should enter downstream prose or remain audit-only activations.
Whether the long-range membership and topology models are intended mechanisms across the four-pericope window or only productive analogies without referential continuity.
